# Principal Handoff 0.5 (vendored)

The record schemas of Principal Handoff Core 0.5 and its Acts 0.5 and Decisions 0.5 extensions, and their `records.json`
and `lifecycle.json` cases and core's `terms-digest.json` and `convert.json`, copied unchanged from the specification at
tag `principal-handoff-0.5` (commit 20912e3). Licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`, `NOTICE`).

Muninn speaks 0.6 (`../principal-handoff/`). This is the version before, which a project may still be configured for
during the transition (core 0.6 section 14): its records are checked under 0.5's own rules and held in their 0.6 form,
and what Muninn tells it is converted to 0.5 and checked against these schemas before it is told.
